description: An abstract class 'ComputedRawPage' implementing the 'Page' interface, serving as a base for pages with raw computed content in a documentation or static site generation system.

classes.name: ComputedRawPage
classes.description: An abstract class representing a page with raw computed content, providing methods to retrieve filename and content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the page with a ComputedRaw content object.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename or URI of the page.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the page.

methods.name: getPureContent
methods.description: Returns the pure content, identical to getContent() in this implementation.
